006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.cst.IExpressionVisitor;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
011
012import java.util.List;
013
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015
016/**
017 * The common interface of all Metapath expression nodes.
018 * <p>
019 * Metapath expression nodes represent the different types of expressions that
020 * can appear in a Metapath query, forming a composite structure that can be
021 * traversed and evaluated.
022 *
023 * @since 1.0.0
024 * @see gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.cst.IExpressionVisitor
025 */
026public interface IExpression {
027  /**
028   * Get the text for the expression.
029   *
030   * @return the expression text
031   */
032  @NonNull
033  String getPath();
034
035  /**
036   * Retrieve the child expressions associated with this expression.
037   *
038   * @return a list of expressions, which may be empty
039   */
040  @NonNull
041  List<? extends IExpression> getChildren();
042
043  /**
044   * The minimum expected result type to be produced when evaluating the
045   * expression. The result may be a sub-class or sub-interface of this value.
046   *
047   * @return the base result type
048   */
049  @NonNull
050  default Class<? extends IItem> getBaseResultType() {
051    return IItem.class;
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * The expected result type produced by evaluating the expression. The result
056   * must be the same or a sub-class or sub-interface of the value provided by
057   * {@link #getBaseResultType()}.
058   * <p>
059   * This method can be overloaded to provide static analysis of the expression to
060   * determine a more specific result type.
061   *
062   * @return the result type
063   */
064  @NonNull
065  default Class<? extends IItem> getStaticResultType() {
066    return getBaseResultType();
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Produce a string representation of this expression including the expression's
071   * name.
072   * <p>
073   * This method can be overloaded to provide a more appropriate representation of
074   * the expression.
075   *
076   * @return a string representing the data elements of the expression
077   */
078  @SuppressWarnings("null")
079  @NonNull
080  default String toCSTString() {
081    return String.format("%s[]", getClass().getName());
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Provides a double dispatch callback for visitor handling.
086   *
087   * @param dynamicContext
088   *          the dynamic evaluation context
089   * @param focus
090   *          the outer focus of the expression
091   * @return the result of evaluation
092   */
093  @NonNull
094  ISequence<? extends IItem> accept(@NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext, @NonNull ISequence<?> focus);
095
096  /**
097   * Provides a double dispatch callback for visitor handling.
098   *
099   * @param <RESULT>
100   *          the type of the evaluation result
101   * @param <CONTEXT>
102   *          the type of the visitor context
103   * @param visitor
104   *          the visitor calling this method
105   * @param context
106   *          the visitor context
107   * @return the result of evaluation
108   */
109  <RESULT, CONTEXT> RESULT accept(@NonNull IExpressionVisitor<RESULT, CONTEXT> visitor, @NonNull CONTEXT context);
110}
